newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 72.9 bln marks in repo tender at 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 72.9 bln marks in repo tender at 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it allocated 72.9 billion marks of securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed rate of three percent, the rate that has prevailed since late August.
A repo pact for 72.0 billion marks at a fixed three percent expires today, Wednesday, so a net 900 million marks is flowing into the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 270.1 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. It accepted 27.0 percent of the bids.
